column2: CONTEXT 256K SWEEP 2026-09-15 — body x one long rung (262,144; GLM-4.7-Flash 202,752 = its native ceiling).
METHOD: llama-server invoked directly with each start script's exec flags; only --ctx-size varies (context256_bodies.sh).
n_ctx = the server's own /props reading (must equal the ask). VRAM = raw nvidia-smi MiB: loaded, then the peak while the deep prompt is read.
decode_tps = best of 2 warm ~200-token replies. deep_* = one prompt fitted with the server's tokenizer to ~230,000 tokens
(190,000 for GLM-4.7-Flash, 150,000 for the slow Q8 DeepSeek) carrying three sealed codes at ~5/50/95% depth; codes_hit = quoted back.
CAVEAT: three model downloads (~340 GB) ran during the sweep, competing for disk and page cache — load times are upper bounds.
